title:
Direct growth inhibition assay of total airborne fungi with
application of biocide-treated malt extract agar
author: Er, Sunar, et al.

steps.title: Prepare sorbate‑MEA mixture
steps.instruction: Add potassium sorbate to malt extract agar (MEA) to obtain a final concentration of 0.03% (w/v).

steps.title: Sterilize agar mixture
steps.instruction: Autoclave the sorbate‑MEA mixture at 121 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Dispense agar into plates
steps.instruction: In a laminar flow hood, pour 20 mL of the sterilized sorbate‑MEA into each pre‑sterilized Petri dish measuring 90 mm × 15 mm, maintaining aseptic conditions.

steps.title: Seal plates
steps.instruction: Allow the agar to solidify, then seal each plate with Parafilm.

steps.title: Prepare control plates
steps.instruction: Repeat the above steps using malt extract agar without potassium sorbate to generate control plates under the same conditions.

steps.title: Maintain sterile environment
steps.instruction: Perform all steps inside a laminar flow hood to ensure aseptic conditions.
